cause: tool/findings_update_finding/refused: <id> is candidate, and this call doesn't confirm it
change: When update_finding carries method with other fields and no status on a finding that isn't confirmed, the other fields are saved and the reply says method was not recorded (it is kept only with status=confirmed, with evidence and reproduction steps). A call with method alone is still refused.
reason: A regression from the confirm-loop fix (82ab380), visible in every targeted trace: the refusal threw away the other fields and the planner resent the call 35-46 times, which collapsed 3 of 8 round-1 candidate runs. Merged on its tests and the 77 records read; a judge round with 2-3 runs a side couldn't add much for its cost.
